subject: Request: RFP bakeoff credit uplift for Wellscope pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Ruiz <dana.ruiz@wellscope.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP bakeoff credit proposal

Hi Dana —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, we can provide a pilot allowance to support the Wellscope RFP bakeoff. Initial proposal: 8,000 token-equivalent credits valid for 30 days and priority support during evaluation.

I attached a compact summary of what the credits cover and a short checklist for your technical team (see attached: Wellscope_RFP_v3.pdf). If you need more runway or want us to sponsor a parallel benchmarking sprint, let me know the target token volume and timeline and I’ll loop in Sales Ops for approval.

Next steps: reply with the target ingestion pattern (avg tokens/request, peak concurrency) or suggest a time this week for a short sync.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: Wellscope_RFP_v3.pdf (summary, 220KB)

From: Dana Ruiz <dana.ruiz@wellscope.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Wellscope Procurement <procurement@wellscope.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP bakeoff credit proposal

Marissa —

Appreciate the quick follow. The team reviewed the summary. For a fair head-to-head with our incumbent, we’d need closer to 15k token units over 30 days, and confirmation of SOC 2 type II evidence for the hosted API. Timeline: evaluation needs to start 2026-06-01 to meet procurement windows.

Can Redwood commit to the 15k uplift conditionally (if we select Redwood to the shortlist), and will you share the SOC 2 report or a read-only portal link? Procurement prefers written confirmation before issuing the PO.

Thanks —
Dana Ruiz
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Wellscope
dana.ruiz@wellscope.com

Attachment: Wellscope_RFP_v3.pdf (annotated)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: RFP bakeoff credit proposal

Team — forwarding Wellscope request. They want 15k tokens over 30 days + SOC 2 access; evaluation start 2026-06-01. Deal ID: DEAL-2026-0342.

Ask: can Sales Ops authorize a discretionary uplift from the standard 8k -> 15k for this RFP? Procurement wants written confirmation they can include with PO. Also Neha, can you confirm the SOC2 sharing process (read-only artifact vs summary) we should provide for RFPs?

Context: Wellscope is in healthcare; high sensitivity. I’m proposing we approve the uplift conditioned on a shortlist commit (we can mark it as contingent in the email to them).

Thanks —
Marissa

-----Original Message Follows-----

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP bakeoff credit proposal

Marissa —

I reviewed. Approve a conditional uplift to 12,000 token units (from standard 8k) without further exec sign-off. For anything above 12k we need VP sign-off; please flag if you want me to escalate to Kendra.

Neha — can you provide the standard SOC 2 sharing blurb we send to procurement? If a full report is needed we can arrange an NDA read-only access; otherwise a certified attestation + auditor contact usually satisfies procurement.

I’ll attach the approved_credit_matrix.csv for your outbound to Wellscope (change the note to say "conditional on shortlist selection").

-Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: approved_credit_matrix.csv (stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP bakeoff credit proposal

Ben/Marissa —

SOC 2 sharing: our standard practice is to provide a summary attestation + contact for auditor verification. For procurement requests that require the full report we send under an NDA and provide read-only access to the SOC portal. I can prepare the attestation language for the outbound email; Marissa, copy me on the response and I’ll include the compliance note and the link instructions.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Ruiz <dana.ruiz@wellscope.com>, Wellscope Procurement <procurement@wellscope.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T16:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP bakeoff credit proposal — conditional approval

Hi Dana —

Thanks for the clarity. We can provide a conditional uplift to 12,000 token-equivalent credits over a 30-day evaluation window, contingent on Wellscope shortlisting Redwood for the bakeoff. We’ll mark the credit delivery in writing so procurement can reference it with the PO (Deal: DEAL-2026-0342). Attached is the approved credit matrix showing the allocation.

On SOC 2: we can provide a summary attestation immediately. If procurement requires the full report we will arrange NDA-based, read-only access to our security portal — I’ve copied our Security lead (Neha) who will provide the exact language.

Proposed next action: I’ll send a one-page confirmation email (formal credit note) for procurement to attach to the PO. Would you like me to include an explicit contingent clause ("credits delivered only upon shortlist confirmation")? If so, we’ll add that sentence verbatim.

Best —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: approved_credit_matrix.csv (redwood internal stub)
